messages:
elaine: Quick sync on the billing ingestion outage remediation. Postmortem has actions but we need a concrete runbook and owner handoff for the backfill + invoice adjustments.

rahul: I can take the backfill orchestration. Plan: dry-run on replica, smoke-test diff for a random sample of 200 customers, then schedule prod backfill.

sam: I'll handle customer adjustments and the credits ledger entries. Need a reproducible query & delta calc so accounting can audit.

elaine: Suggested canonical query for reconciliation (use the v2 ledger):
```
-- per-customer reconciled tokens in window
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS reconciled_tokens
FROM billing.token_ledger_v2
WHERE event_time >= '2026-03-10' AND event_time < '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
Please run on the replica and upload CSV to the private gist.

rahul: Dry-run scheduled Thu 05:00 UTC on replica. Will post gist link and sample diff. Plan to include an idempotency key on ingest to prevent duplicate counts from aggregator retries.

ops-bot: Reminder: please request a maintenance window for the prod backfill. Ops needs exact timeline + rollback plan.

sam: For credits calc: suggested_credit_usd = ROUND(MAX(0, billed_tokens - reconciled_tokens) * unit_price_per_token, 2). I'll provide a CSV format: customer_id, billed_tokens, reconciled_tokens, delta_tokens, unit_price, suggested_credit_usd, review_flag.

elaine: Add review_flag = true when delta_tokens / billed_tokens > 0.02 or delta_tokens > 5000. That helps prioritize manual checks.

rahul: Noted. Also adding a fast sanity check in the backfill: total_tokens_post_backfill should equal max(total_tokens_current, total_tokens_expected) to avoid undercounting.

finance-bot: Auto-note: attach GL impact simulation for credits (estimated $Xk) once CSV uploaded.

sam: I'll draft customer-facing language after I see the CSV. Short template: "We observed a reporting delay that impacted usage between Mar 10-16. We've corrected your usage and applied any applicable credits. Contact support for questions."

elaine: Ops runbook items: how to run dry-run query, how to verify sample customers, rollback steps (restore snapshot + reverse-apply patch), contact list (rahul, sam, ela ine, oncall). rahul: can you write the runbook PR and link it to the postmortem? ETA: Fri EOD.

rahul: Will open PR with runbook + backfill script. Adding automated tests for idempotency guard. Targeting prod run Mon 03/16 03:00 UTC if ops approves.

ops-bot: Ops window requested: Mon 03/16 03:00-04:30 UTC. Please confirm in #eng-oncall after PR and risk assessment.

elaine: Ok setting weekly status check until credits posted and one alert cycle passes. Thanks all.
